description:
Tree entries are all rendered; upstream only shows a window of maxVisibleLines centered on the selected entry.

## Current Elixir behavior

OctoPi.TUI.Components.TreeSelector.render/2 calls:
  Tree.render_lines(state.filtered_nodes, leaf_id: ..., selected_id: ...)
which renders ALL filtered_nodes unconditionally. On large sessions this could produce hundreds of
lines, overflowing the overlay.

maxVisibleLines defaults to 20 and is not wired to terminal height.
In interactive.ex dispatch_slash_command("tree"), TreeSelector.new is called without max_visible_lines:.
The terminal height (state.height) is available but not passed.

## Expected upstream behavior (TreeList.render())

```typescript
const startIndex = Math.max(
  0,
  Math.min(
    this.selectedIndex - Math.floor(this.maxVisibleLines / 2),
    this.filteredNodes.length - this.maxVisibleLines,
  ),
);
const endIndex = Math.min(startIndex + this.maxVisibleLines, this.filteredNodes.length);
// render only filteredNodes[startIndex..endIndex]
```

The window is centered on selectedIndex: the selection is kept at the midpoint of the visible area.
When selectedIndex is near the start or end, the window clamps to the boundary.

### maxVisibleLines from terminal height
```typescript
const maxVisibleLines = Math.max(5, Math.floor(terminalHeight / 2));
```
Upstream passes terminalHeight (the terminal row count) to TreeSelectorComponent.

## Elixir gaps

1. render/2 renders all filtered_nodes; needs to slice to startIndex..endIndex
2. TreeSelector.new in interactive.ex does not receive max_visible_lines from state.height
3. max_visible_lines is hardcoded to 20 in the struct default

## Where to fix

apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex:
- render/2: compute startIndex/endIndex from selected_index and max_visible_lines; slice
  filtered_nodes before passing to Tree.render_lines/2

apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:
- dispatch_slash_command("tree"): pass max_visible_lines: max(5, div(state.height, 2))
  to TreeSelector.new

## Verification
Run /tree in a session with many entries (>20). Confirm only ~N/2 rows are visible (N = terminal
height), and that navigating up/down scrolls the window so the selection stays centered.
Also confirm max_visible_lines page-up/page-down still jumps the correct distance.
title: /tree windowed display: render only maxVisibleLines around selected index
